description:
FOUND (s526w1, Data-Dumper census): Data::Dumper's PP _dump writes a main-package glob as `*::foo` and reads its slots through `*{"::foo"}{$k}`.
Probe (scratch p-gl3.pl / p-gl4.pl):
  no strict; print \*{"::xy"} == \*{"xy"} ? "same" : "diff";                       # perl same, PCL diff
  our $foo = 5; print refaddr(*{"::foo"}{SCALAR}) == refaddr(\$foo), ${*{"::foo"}{SCALAR}};   # perl same 5, PCL diff undef
  eval(q{\*{"::\400"}}) == \*{chr 256}                                                # perl same, PCL diff
Rows: Data-Dumper dumper.t 31, 33, 34, 36, 37, 39, 40, 42 and 178, 180, 181, 183 (Purity: the glob's SCALAR slot is not the variable, so `b => \$foo` is not "seen" and prints \5 for do{my $o}) and bugs.t 12, 13 (the eval of the dumped glob is another glob).  Layer: runtime symbolic-name resolution (perl: a leading "::" is "main::").
subject: A symbolic glob / stash name with a LEADING "::" is not main:: -- `\*{"::foo"} == \*{"foo"}` is false in PCL, `*{"::foo"}{SCALAR}` is a fresh empty scalar (perl: the same glob, $main::foo); Data::Dumper names every main glob *{"::foo"}
